# Historical Blender stage evidence audit

**Scope.** The supplied files are stage-event logs, not images or complete geometry. They support a narrow audit of recorded execution, not a visual or physical assessment. The supplied selection contains no call transcripts documenting teacher advice, student patch commands, failed commands, acceptance decisions, or mechanism updates. Their absence here is not proof that none occurred elsewhere. Original and publication copies must not be treated as independent trials.

## Recorded transitions and counterexamples

- In one historical test, the log records local seeding, the **start** of Python validation, build start and completion, render configuration, scene statistics, save completion, reload completion, and render completion, in that order. The seed controls Python random and NumPy only, not remote model sampling. Neither a validation-completed event nor a quality decision is recorded. [SE0177, `/srv/lab-disks/disk2/users/xymo/Documents/Codex/2026-11-02/scene-rsi-rsi-1-3d-blender/outputs/scene_rsi_v3/results/historical_r1_C2_start/test/bw_0016/1/steps/001/stage_events.jsonl`, lines 1–13.]
- Later steps in that same run each record another build, save, load and completed render; mesh counts change from 406 to 424 to 445. These are recorded successive executions, not evidence of the specific edits that caused the changes or of improvement. [SE0177, path above, lines 3–13; SE0176, `/srv/lab-disks/disk2/users/xymo/Documents/Codex/2026-11-02/scene-rsi-rsi-1-3d-blender/outputs/scene_rsi_v3/results/historical_r1_C2_start/test/bw_0016/1/steps/002/stage_events.jsonl`, lines 3–13; SE0178, `/srv/lab-disks/disk2/users/xymo/Documents/Codex/2026-11-02/scene-rsi-rsi-1-3d-blender/outputs/scene_rsi_v3/results/historical_r1_C2_start/test/bw_0016/1/steps/003/stage_events.jsonl`, lines 3–13.]
- Stage ordering is not universal. An older completed log records build completion, save **start**, then render start and completion, but has no save-completed or load events. That omission does not itself establish a failed save. [SE0391, `/srv/lab-disks/disk2/users/xymo/Documents/Codex/2026-11-02/scene-rsi-rsi-1-3d-blender/archive/scene/experiments/scene_rsi_v2_2/results/r2/fixed_h/H0/fixed_version_test/commons_49800017/steps/002/stage_events.jsonl`, lines 1–7.]
- Conversely, the complete first-step log for one selection ends at build start; its next step records a completed build and render. The first log does not give a failure reason, and the later completion does not establish what repair, if any, occurred. [SE0195, `/srv/lab-disks/disk2/users/xymo/Documents/Codex/2026-11-02/scene-rsi-rsi-1-3d-blender/outputs/scene_rsi_v3/results/historical_r1_C2_start/selection/bw_0031/1/steps/001/stage_events.jsonl`, lines 1–3; SE0194, `/srv/lab-disks/disk2/users/xymo/Documents/Codex/2026-11-02/scene-rsi-rsi-1-3d-blender/outputs/scene_rsi_v3/results/historical_r1_C2_start/selection/bw_0031/1/steps/002/stage_events.jsonl`, lines 2–13.]

## Parts, checks and decisions

- The archive records actual Boolean operations during a build: successive UNIONs on `Box.061`, with vertex counts changing, before build and render completion. This establishes named operation/target relations, not the intended part semantics or successful physical contact. [SE0402, `/srv/lab-disks/disk2/users/xymo/Documents/Codex/2026-11-02/scene-rsi-rsi-1-3d-blender/archive/scene/experiments/scene_rsi_v2_2/results/r2/fixed_h/r1_C2/fixed_version_test/commons_49800017/steps/002/stage_events.jsonl`, lines 2–8, 135–139.]
- A counterexample to inferring a completed scene from completed part operations is an older log with many completed DIFFERENCE operations on named balls but no subsequent build-completed or render event in the complete file. [SE0415, `/srv/lab-disks/disk2/users/xymo/Documents/Codex/2026-11-02/scene-rsi-rsi-1-3d-blender/archive/scene/experiments/scene_rsi_v2_2/results/r1/fixed_h/H0/fixed_version_test/commons_92056365/steps/001/stage_events.jsonl`, lines 1–6, 39–46.]
- The logs report renderer settings and geometry totals, not explicit pose, camera, lighting or material inspections. For example, a completed render records Cycles, CPU, 16 samples and 512 × 288 output; it does not establish framing, lighting quality or material fidelity. [SE0183, `/srv/lab-disks/disk2/users/xymo/Documents/Codex/2026-11-02/scene-rsi-rsi-1-3d-blender/outputs/scene_rsi_v3/results/historical_r1_C2_start/test/bw_0005/1/steps/001/stage_events.jsonl`, lines 5–13.]
- H-labelled directories show executions under those labels, but the stage events alone do not document an H/M or mechanism update, its rationale, or its effect on quality. For example, H10 has a completed build and render; that is not an acceptance decision. [SE0243, `/srv/lab-disks/disk2/users/xymo/Documents/Codex/2026-11-02/scene-rsi-rsi-1-3d-blender/outputs/scene_rsi_v3/results/H10/selection/bw_0031/1/steps/001/stage_events.jsonl`, lines 2–13.]

**Conclusion.** Recorded render completion, geometry counts, zero remaining Boolean modifiers, an `ok` flag if encountered elsewhere, or AABB bounds do not establish visual fidelity or physical contact. These selected logs do not permit separating teacher recommendations from student implementation or acceptance, nor do they justify generalizing outcomes across all scenes.
